newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks steady to lower, hoteliers fall.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks steady to lower, hoteliers fall.

text.p: Croatian stocks were steady to lower on Friday with some further losses in leading hoteliers as the market waited for a new signal from investors.
* Only one of 11 traded issues rose, five fell and five were unchanged.
* Volume fell to 3,923 units, turnover down to 2.6 million kuna.
* The only gainer, Zagrebacka Banka, rose 10 kuna to a new high of 1,040 but sold only five shares.
* Top decliner was hotelier Istraturist, falling 16 kuna to 313 on volume of 50 units.
* Most active Podravka edged down 3.90 kuna to 274 on volume of 2,229 shares.
